$comment: Families whose @sneat/extension-<family>-contract package this repo owns and publishes. Seeded empty at Phase 0 (no family migrated yet — see spec/features/ext-contracts-monorepo/README.md, sneat-co/sneat-libs). The tier-coherence check (tools/tier-coherence/) reads this file to build its synthetic consumer; add a family here in the same change that adds its libs/<family>/ lib and publishes its first version from this repo. Each entry is either a plain string (npm package is @sneat/extension-<entry>-contract, the default — matches the libs/<entry>/ dir and the family:<entry> project tag) or, when the published npm name doesn't follow that pattern, an object { "dir": "<libs/ dir and family tag>", "npmName": "<middle segment of @sneat/extension-<npmName>-contract>" } — see kids-club/sneat-team/rsvp-express below for the three cases in this repo so far.
